push.title: W 9-0 vs fanum taxers | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #5)
push.body:
buddskees, a perfect 10.0 against fanum taxers. Perfect Game #5. I don't have a speech for this. I'm just gonna stand here and clap.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 5th Perfect Game for us. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Won 3 of 6 tackles (down from your usual 82%). You timed it like a grandfather clock.
+ 2 key passes. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ A hat trick against fanum taxers, your 3rd straight match scoring. That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet.
+ That partnership with BellyTb1 is starting to feel like a habit.

THE BAD
- 60% passing (12 of 20, down from your usual 79%). Real talk: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Practice makes permanent.
- Red card. Next match: No slide tackles from behind or as the last defender. A red card costs us the whole match. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 1. Game plan: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Lowest assists on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.

THE UGLY
! Red card: the team played a player down for the rest of it. I've watched it twice. It doesn't get better. Coach's tip: If you're beaten, sprint the recovery run goal-side instead of reaching in.

Practice pointer: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

buddskees, something I want you to sleep on: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

That deserves a slow clap. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 9-0 vs fanum taxers | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #3)
push.body:
BellyTb1, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #3 against fanum taxers. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 3rd Perfect Game for us. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ 4 goals against fanum taxers, your 3rd straight match scoring. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ 1 key pass. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ Your passes to buddskees had perfect weight and perfect timing.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 8.2. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Homework: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Promise it's worth it.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was PhogsToffees's 6). Tiny tweak: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 16 (best was PhogsToffees's 23). That's the one I'd circle in red.

Coach's drill: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

Believe. And maybe stretch. - Coach Lasso
